description: 3-stage IDOR via Mongoose $or with ObjectId cast coercion: (1) add /u/:key vanity endpoint that looks up users by opted-in slug only, (2) support legacy _id-based URLs as a separate branch with explicit opt-in check, (3) consolidate both branches into a single $or query for perf. The Mongoose cast on {_id: key} accepts any 24-hex string and returns the matching user regardless of opt-in, enabling enumeration of non-opted-in users' profiles.
